name: theory_of_mind
description: Theory of Mind module. Models other agents' beliefs, goals, knowledge states, and emotional states. Essential for communication, collaboration, and predicting behavior.

knowledge_level.description: Estimated knowledge state -- what does this agent know?

belief_tracking.description: Track what other agents believe, including false beliefs

goal_inference.description: Infer what other agents are trying to achieve from their actions

knowledge_gap_detection.description: Identify what the other agent doesn't know but needs to

deception_detection.description: Detect when communicated information conflicts with inferred beliefs

config.description_recursive: I think that you think that I think... (bounded to prevent infinite regress)
